data.summary: Client-focused Capital Markets Operations professional with 4.8 years of experience in Client Operations, Custody Operations, Trade Settlement, Reconciliation, and issue resolution. Experienced in managing client and counterparty inquiries, operational requests, escalations, settlement exceptions, and follow-ups through resolution. Strong ability to coordinate with cross-functional teams, maintain service quality, meet SLA-driven deadlines, analyze operational issues, prepare service and reconciliation reports, maintain accurate records, and identify process gaps for continuous improvement. Hands-on exposure to Equities, Fixed Income, Mutual Funds, FX, and Repo/Reverse Repo across global markets.

responsibilities: Supported client operations and custody settlement activities, including client onboarding and transition support.
Managed and responded to operational queries and requests related to trade settlement, reconciliation, and custody activities, ensuring timely follow-up.
Investigated cash and securities reconciliation breaks and settlement exceptions; coordinated with relevant internal teams until resolution.
Acted as a liaison between middle-office, reconciliation, and operations teams to facilitate clear communication and timely issue resolution.
Managed daily queue allocation, workflow tracking, and work prioritization to support SLA commitments and service delivery.
Prepared and maintained SOPs, process documentation, and operational guidelines to ensure consistent and accurate service delivery.
Identified operational gaps and contributed to process improvement initiatives focused on workflow efficiency and service quality.
Maintained accurate operational records and supported transition activities through structured documentation and follow-up.
Handled client and counterparty queries and escalations related to trade settlement, payments, reconciliation, and operational exceptions, ensuring professional follow-up through closure.
Built effective working relationships with custodians, agent banks, counterparties, Euroclear, Clearstream, and internal stakeholders to resolve service issues.
Managed end-to-end trade lifecycle activities including trade booking, validation, confirmation, settlement, reconciliation, and exception management across global markets.
Performed cash and securities reconciliation, investigated settlement breaks and trade failures, identified causes, and drove timely resolution within SLA.
Coordinated with cross-functional teams to resolve domestic and international settlement, payment, transfer, and custody-related issues.
Processed custody settlements through FED, DTC, CREST, SWIFT, and FAX instructions, while ensuring market cut-off and service timelines were met.
Executed and monitored transactions across Equities, Fixed Income, Mutual Funds, FX, and Repo/Reverse Repo products.
Processed DVP, RVP, and FOP transactions and handled amendments, cancellations, FX currency matching, and settlement requirements.
Prepared SOD, MOD, EOD, reconciliation, and operational reports to support service monitoring, control checks, SLA adherence, audit readiness, and regulatory requirements.
Allocated and posted dividend and interest income accurately to client accounts and supported accurate custody/accounting records.
Identified recurring operational issues and service gaps and contributed to process improvements and workflow enhancements.
Maintained 99.8% accuracy while managing high-volume transactions in a deadline-driven environment.
Mentored new team members and supported knowledge transfer, process consistency, and service-quality standards.

Infosys BPM Ltd. — Process Specialist – Trade Settlement 22 January 2026 – 24 July 2026 | Pune
Supported client operations and custody settlement activities, including client onboarding and transition support. • Managed and responded to operational queries and requests related to trade settlement, reconciliation, and custody activities, ensuring timely follow-up. • Investigated cash and securities reconciliation breaks and settlement exceptions; coordinated with relevant internal teams until resolution. • Acted as a liaison between middle-office, reconciliation, and operations teams to facilitate clear communication and timely issue resolution. • Managed daily queue allocation, workflow tracking, and work prioritization to support SLA commitments and service delivery. • Prepared and maintained SOPs, process documentation, and operational guidelines to ensure consistent and accurate service delivery. • Identified operational gaps and contributed to process improvement initiatives focused on workflow efficiency and service quality. • Maintained accurate operational records and supported transition activities through structured documentation and follow-up.
State Street Services Pvt. Ltd., Pune — Senior Associate (Trade Processing & Settlement) 01 December 2021 – 15 January 2026 | Pune
Handled client and counterparty queries and escalations related to trade settlement, payments, reconciliation, and operational exceptions, ensuring professional follow-up through closure. • Built effective working relationships with custodians, agent banks, counterparties, Euroclear, Clearstream, and internal stakeholders to resolve service issues. • Managed end-to-end trade lifecycle activities including trade booking, validation, confirmation, settlement, reconciliation, and exception management across global markets. • Performed cash and securities reconciliation, investigated settlement breaks and trade failures, identified causes, and drove timely resolution within SLA. • Coordinated with cross-functional teams to resolve domestic and international settlement, payment, transfer, and custody-related issues. • Processed custody settlements through FED, DTC, CREST, SWIFT, and FAX instructions, while ensuring market cut-off and service timelines were met. • Executed and monitored transactions across Equities, Fixed Income, Mutual Funds, FX, and Repo/Reverse Repo products. • Processed DVP, RVP, and FOP transactions and handled amendments, cancellations, FX currency matching, and settlement requirements. • Prepared SOD, MOD, EOD, reconciliation, and operational reports to support service monitoring, control checks, SLA adherence, audit readiness, and regulatory requirements. • Allocated and posted dividend and interest income accurately to client accounts and supported accurate custody/accounting records. • Identified recurring operational issues and service gaps and contributed to process improvements and workflow enhancements. • Maintained 99.8% accuracy while managing high-volume transactions in a deadline-driven environment. • Mentored new team members and supported knowledge transfer, process consistency, and service-quality standards.
